styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent festive premium Chinese liquor visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep festive red #A6262C, warm gold #D4AF37, soft cream #F7EFDD and one celadon-green accent #9CC49C, with charcoal text #2D2D2D reserved for body copy on light panels; warm studio key light with soft fill and gentle contact shadows for product shots, warm directional side light for dark scene shots; classic Chinese serif (Songti-style) short bold headlines in warm gold on red panels or charcoal on cream panels; consistent thin gold-line traditional motifs used as decorative frames only; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the upright ceramic jug shown stable and centered with a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
